Full self-description of the family holding: the crop list, the composts and preparations made on the farm, the Argencert and Ecocert certification, the weekly baskets, the email and the Facebook page.

notes: The registered point falls outside any municipality; the nearest locality is Vista Alegre Sur, 2,9 km away, in the Vista Alegre municipality.
